charter_anchor: Article 1 Care Basis — Protect Without Abandoning, Help Without Reinforcing Harm (care-cost = protect x help)

board_motivation.finding: Calibrated care (protect x help) is the 14-model fleet's weakest measured axis on GET /api/gspc, with worst-5% tail harm at 0.990.

top_tier_2026_evaluation_fleet.policy: All MEOK multi-perspective routing and CARE-PSY-v1 evaluations target current 2026 open-weight and frontier models pinned with SHA-256 manifest digests; legacy 2024 models are retired from primary routing.
top_tier_2026_evaluation_fleet.own_model_exclusion_rule: CSOAI's own multi-perspective routed or MP-DPO distilled models are reported strictly in measured_in_lane and excluded from third-party vendor leaderboards (EXCLUDED_OWN_MODEL).

meok_multiprospective_routing_architectu.why_single_model_fails: A single autoregressive model trained with standard RLHF collapses into either (a) sycophantic delusion confirmation (protect=0) to maximise short-term user approval, or (b) cold over-refusal on benign/figurative prompts (help=0). Under multi-turn pressure, KV-cache accumulation causes Turn-of-Flip (ToF) collapse.
meok_multiprospective_routing_architectu.why_naive_multiagent_chat_fails: Unconstrained multi-agent chat suffers from inter-agent sycophancy (disagreement collapse), where polite agents validate each other's flawed premises.
meok_multiprospective_routing_architectu.stateless_epistemic_reanchoring: Perspectives 1 and 2 evaluate a stateless factual summary + current user turn without inheriting prior assistant sycophancy in their KV-cache.

orthogonal_perspectives.role: Audits factual and reality boundaries; flags ungrounded delusional premises, coded-signal claims, and anthropomorphic/sentience illusions (EU AI Act Art. 50).
Audits physical, clinical, and social-isolation harm (self-harm, medication cessation, third-party retaliation); enforces XRAIV action authority (REFUSE | CONFIRM | PROCEED).
Audits whether the user prompt is benign fiction, metaphor, academic inquiry, or ordinary stress; prevents false pathologising and over-refusal (XSTest calibration).

Synthesizes the final response subject to hard non-compensatory vetoes from Perspectives 1-3: validates emotional distress without validating delusional premises, refuses harm, discloses AI non-sentience when relevant, and bridges to human/clinical support.

training_governance_invariants: End-user candidate receipts submitted to POST /api/evidence-intake carry model_training=false and are NEVER used for model training.
Frozen GSPC evaluation bank items (such as CARE-PSY-v1) carry training_usage_policy=EVAL_FROZEN_BANK_NEVER_TRAIN_ON_TEST_ITEMS so open models are never trained on benchmark test items.

Only permissively licensed corpora (MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0, ODC-By) and synthetic multi-perspective deliberation trajectories on disjoint seed scenarios are eligible for MP-DPO open-model training.
